title: feat(nmcovers): axis-cover of M and O at t+1 on #7211: reverse HOLD, face HOLD
science: Axis-cover on the #7211 y-probes. Its Axis(M)/Axis(O) table is character-for-character the same as #7278's, because the two seeds share a probe signature class. Defines axis_cover so that empty M with 3-axis O counts as HOLD -- inconsistent with #7278/#7280/#7281, which make empty fail.
